Hi Jordan / Elena —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can validate Dedicated performance against your SLOs: 95th pct latency target of <=120ms for conversational summaries (avg payload ~512 tokens), streaming support for progressive sentence delivery, and sustained reserved throughput of ~100 requests/sec during peak windows with 24 concurrent model sessions.

Recap of constraints you shared:
- Model: open-weights LLM (parameter range ~13B–70B), runs with KV-cache enabled.
- Streaming: requires chunked responses (SSE) to surface partial answers within 60ms of token emission.
- Security: dedicated VPC + customer-managed keys (we have suggested Private path if you need on-prem).

Proposed validation plan (short):
1) Baseline microbenchmarks: our GPUs (A10G, A100 40GB, H100 80GB) using a 512-token profile and your sample corpus.
2) Sustained run: 30-minute tail-latency window to measure 95/99 pct under target throughput.
3) Streaming validation: measure token emission latency and burst behavior with concurrency.
4) Cost/throughput matrix: recommend reserved throughput and fallback routing for capacity events.

Can you: (a) confirm we can run the supplied harness against a representative sample (I attached a sample_requests.jsonl), and (b) confirm your preferred timeline for a two-day validation window next week?

Attachments: sample_requests.jsonl (example payloads)

Next steps from us once you confirm: schedule cluster time, baseline runs on A10G/A100/H100, and share a concise matrix with recommended reserved throughput + GPU fit.

Thanks — I’ll loop Rishi and Priyom to size the reserved pool based on the call.

Thanks Ava / Jordan — quick sizing notes ahead of the runs. Top-line guidance (back-of-envelope):

Assumptions:
- Model working set: 34B with KV cache; average response ~512 tokens; request payloads small.
- Target: 95th <= 120ms, reserved throughput target ~110 req/s, concurrency target 24–48 sessions (client creates parallel streams).

Estimated fit:
- A10G (single-socket): best for cost-conscious dev tests. Expect higher tail-latency and limited concurrency. Not recommended for production SLO if you need streaming at sub-120ms at 110 rps.
- A100 40GB: reasonable middle ground. With batching tuned and prefix caching you can hit 95th ~110–140ms depending on batching window. For 110 rps with concurrency ~32 we need a reserved pool of ~6–8 A100 instances (depends on sequence length and eval harness).
- H100 80GB: strongest tail-latency and concurrency headroom. Expect 95th comfortably <120ms for 110 rps at concurrency 48 with a reserved pool of 4–6 H100s. H100 increases chip-cost but reduces instance count and can improve cost-per-inference for heavy streaming workloads.

Recommended validation matrix for the runs (we will bring exact test scripts):
- Short baseline: A10G / A100 / H100 single-run latency profiles (p50/p95/p99).
- Sustained: 30-minute run @ target 110 rps; measure tail-latency and memory pressure.
- Streaming: instrument token emission times and first-chunk latency (SSE).

Deliverables after runs:
- Performance matrix (latency/throughput/concurrency) per GPU type
- Suggested reserved throughput and estimated monthly cost delta (A100 vs H100)
- Failure/fallback recommendation (auto-scale thresholds, fallback to smaller model variant)

Priyom — I’ll need the benchmark template and cost calc to attach before Aug 24 so we can share to Jordan ahead of the window.

Rishi
